_comment: Complex Nutrition food profiles. Every config/foodprofiles/*.json in any mod is read. Values are per 100 g (per 100 g of liquid for portionUnit litre); calories in kcal, macros and fiber in g, vitamins and minerals in mg or mcg as USDA lists them (A, D and K in mcg; C, E, calcium, iron and potassium in mg), and vitaminB in % of the daily value. A source that lists % of the daily value can use per100gDV instead (see example 6). Replace the example codes below with your mod's item codes; codes that match nothing are ignored. Full guide: https://github.com/largelyunemployed/VS-Complex-Nutrition/blob/main/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md

profiles.notes: Example 1: a full profile from USDA FoodData Central. One gooseberry item = a 50 g handful.
Example 2: close enough to a vanilla food. Copies its per-100 g values and its 50 g portion.
Example 3: a wildcard covering every dried fruit variant. Drying concentrates everything about 6 times and destroys most vitamin C. Lighter portion.
Example 4: a liquid. Copies apple juice (and its per-litre portion), then replaces one value (vitamin C in mg).
Example 5: a food with no close match, built from the nearest one and corrected.
Example 6: values from a label in % of the daily value go in per100gDV; the game turns them into mg and mcg.
